National-Level Big Shots Flock to My Farm

Về Quê Làm Nông, Dàn Hậu Bối Cấp Quốc Gia Kéo Đến Kín Nhà

description:
Hyeon-Sung, having suffered a severe injury and lost even the spirits that had always been by his side, is left with nothing but low-level spirits incapable of combat. Forced to retire due to the aftereffects of his injury, Hyeon-Sung returns to farming at the urging of a childhood friend.

Wild-grown food, contaminated by the miasma emitted by monsters, has become completely inedible, so the price of food is now determined by its taste. No matter how high-grade the food is, it’s so tasteless compared to what he used to eat that it’s not even worth comparing…

 *“Why are the crops I’ve grown so delicious?!”*

When the crops grown in Hyeon-Sung’s field began to reveal the “true flavor” that had been lost, his quiet rural life was turned upside down. From the nation’s top hunter to a high-ranking Special Operations officer, and even the top stars of the three major entertainment agencies! National-level heavyweights who’ve never known fear begin flocking to this remote corner of the countryside!!

(Source: Naver, translated)
